# StreamDek Mobile v2.0.7

## What's New

- Restored brightness and volume controls in the player: drag the left third of the screen for brightness, the right third for volume, with an on-screen level indicator.
- Restored Live and VOD recognition for M3U/M3U8 playlists, with separate Live TV and VOD rows on Home instead of one mixed list.
- Added a "Clear all" action to the Watchlist page to remove every saved title at once.

## Improvements

- The update-available prompt now stays hidden during sign-in, guest profile creation, profile selection/switching, and PIN entry, and waits three seconds after reaching the main app before appearing.
- The update prompt now dismisses immediately once a download starts, and the download view now dims the app content and highlights the floating navigation with progress instead of being hidden behind the dialog.
- The player's swipe-up-for-channels gesture is now scoped to the middle third of the screen again, so it no longer competes with the restored brightness/volume drag zones.
- Adding an M3U/M3U8 playlist now shows live progress (status text, percentage) plus live/VOD item counts per playlist and overall.
- M3U/M3U8 parsing now preserves custom User-Agent/Referer headers required by some IPTV providers.
- Added regression coverage for M3U/M3U8 playlist parsing, including Live/VOD classification and header preservation.

## Fixes

- Fixed the update prompt appearing over authentication and profile screens instead of only the main app.
- Fixed the update prompt remaining open and blocking download progress after tapping Update Now.
- Fixed M3U/M3U8 playlists losing their Live/VOD classification, item counts, and add-progress feedback.
